slot_change_request: q13-cdcw 2026-10-13 (el1011-qwen-tp8.log SLOT_CHANGE_REQUEST): qwen_rom_tp8 v3 slot cell qkd_cdc_wleaf (cdc_*_*, 128) -- (1) outline 183.72 x 183.72 (the old qfd_cdc_eco_h1 LEF, off the 2.16 um floorplan grid) -> 183.6 x 183.6 (2.16-grid tile inside the slot, same origin); (2) the contract pins are the die generator's aggregated buses; the view carries the real RTL ports on the SAME faces and layers: co[282:0] W/M4 = {l_v, l_sec, l_row, l_data, l_pop}, hi[293:0] N/M5 = {h_lv, h_lsec, h_lrow, h_ldata, h_hand, h_wcon, h_av, h_atag}, ho[318:0] E/M4 = {h_cred, h_wv, h_wsec, h_cv, h_csec, h_cdata, h_ctag, h_fault}, wi[289:0] S/M5 = {w_v, w_sec, w_data, w_tag}, wr[10:0] S/M5 = {w_room, wd_v, wd_tag}, cf S/M5 = c_fault; clock entry ck N/M5 = port clk; hclk, c_arst_n, h_arst_n W/M4; pin offsets from the new LEF; r2: (3) LD 32 leaves the 183.6 x 183.6 slot under-utilised (std ~12k um2, util ~0.36 < 0.45): the outline is the contract slot and is NOT shrunk; (4) interface latency: h_cv / h_c* arrive one HCLK edge later than the old qfd_cdc_eco_h1 view (h_wcon pin flop): the die composition / transport context must take the completion entry on h_cv (it does: h_cv qualifies h_c*), and the landing depth contract is controller CRED <= 32

job.purpose: q13-cdcw: hardened slot-shaped view for the Qwen3-8B ROM TP8 die cell qkd_cdc_wleaf (KV write-side CDC leaf, 128 instances; contract v3 slot cdc_EN_0). RTL = ot_qwen_stream4_cdc_pc MARGIN 1 / LCRED 6 / SYNC 2 / RSEL 1 / RNG 10 with r2 LD 32 + WPIPE 1 (see structural_change; the old qfd_cdc_eco_h1 structure put 19,280 flops on the hclk root) under the cell-name wrapper qkd_cdc_wleaf; reference tile flow, 183.6 x 183.6, M5 cap (PG M5, strap M6, pins M4 W/E, M5 N/S), faces per the slot (co W, hi + clk N, ho E, wi/wr/cf S, hclk + resets W); two clock roots core clk 833.333 ps + hclk 1,024 ps with the old kit's crossing constraints (max-delay datapath budget both ways, no clock groups, no false paths) and per-domain boundary 0.2 T; inhold + outhold deterministic IO hold stages; TT/FF/SS view export; r3 submission (owner clock rule: <= 15,000 sinks per root passes on count): landing depth 64 -> 32 (contract: controller CRED <= 32); h_cv / h_c* arrive one HCLK edge later than the old view (h_wcon pin flop) -- OPEN ITEM for the die lead: NOT yet verified in the transport context; measured pre-route clock figures (gate @0731fd7ed, verdict WARN 0 fail): hclk root 10,376 sinks, clk root 5,621 sinks, TT insertion 193.1..435.5 ps (two async trees in one figure; cts_sink 60 / 60 um changed nothing: 439.9 -> 435.5) -- insertion to be budgeted by the die lead

structural_change: landing depth 64 -> 32, h_wcon registered at its pin with per-group kept one-hot selects, M5 slot cell wrapper. r2 (the r1 kit was refused by the clock rule: hclk root 19,280 sinks, measured TT insertion 442.7 ps): (1) landing storage 64 x 281 -> 32 x 281 flops (LD = the controller's credit count CRED 32; every RD holds a credit and credits return from the synchronised read pointer that the full flag uses, so occupancy <= 32; contract: controller CRED <= 32): hclk root ~10.4k sinks; (2) WPIPE 1: h_wcon registered at its pin (completion path h_cv / h_csec / h_cdata / h_ctag one HCLK edge later: h_cv two edges after h_wcon), one kept pin-flop copy and one kept one-hot entry select per storage column group (wc_bin[0] drove 4,629 loads, port h_wcon 584); (3) h_hand (same-edge hand-off, cycle kept) is the select of one final 2:1 mux: hand-off pointer kept as +0/+1/+2 registers (was a 7-level input cone). No logic between a Gray register and its synchroniser.
